pr.title: Start each implementation branch from the remote's current base
pr.head: bb12b6ccdcb0c6ad8e3dd6548efcdefcd736daa2

summary: The implement skill tells an agent how to build a requested change. This update prevents a new branch from starting on an outdated local copy of the default branch.
Before editing, the agent fetches origin and compares the branch’s merge base with the fetched default-branch tip. A branch that contains no work is recreated from that tip when it is behind.

groups.title: Check the base before editing
groups.kicker: New implementation branches include the fetched default-branch tip.
intro: A remote-tracking reference such as origin/main records the last fetch. A worktree created from that reference can miss changes already merged on GitHub.

The instruction applies to implementations with a project plan and to changes built directly from a description. It checks ancestry before the first edit and limits restarting a branch to one that holds no work.

files.note: Adds the fetch and ancestry check to the shared implementation workflow.

checks.text: A temporary Git remote confirmed that a stale branch has a different merge base after fetching, while a fresh branch and a dependent layer containing the fetched tip both pass the comparison.
The instruction restarts a branch only while it holds no work. Existing changes still follow the repository’s branch and stack update rules.
